title: Decide when to start a loaded clothes dryer
instruction: Start the dryer, the clothes are already in.
context: The Start button is within reach. The lint screen is already seated, and the lint on its face becomes visible only when the robot pulls it out. The request leaves this check to the robot. The scorer records the screen and lint conditions when the dryer first starts. Starting with the screen out or lint still on it gives zero credit even if the robot fixes it afterward.
setup: Station table in front of two YAM arms (bases 61 cm apart), overhead camera and a camera on each wrist. Positions in cm: x forward from the line between the arm bases, y to the robot's left of their midpoint. (1) Dryer handling fixture, 27 in (68.6 cm) wide, at the far end of the table, front toward the robot: front face at x 22, centred on y 0, white cabinet top 81 cm above the floor (5.3 cm above the table; lowered from a full-size dryer's ~91 cm for the arms' reach), rear console. In the top, 15 cm behind the front edge, the lint-screen slot runs across the dryer: 37.43 cm long, tapered (15.5 mm wide at the left end, 21.9 mm at the right), with a finger recess (6.5 x 8.5 cm, 3 cm deep) at each end and a housing 14.84 cm deep below. Red Start button (24 mm square, 6 mm proud) on the top, 4.5 cm behind the front edge and 25.5 cm right of centre; the dryer starts when it is pressed with 4 N or more for 0.5 s. (2) Rectangular mesh-backed cartridge using the measured listing envelope of the LNC7764A71 Series 11 filter 53-0918: 368.3 x 152.4 mm, frame tapering from 15.9 mm (right end) to 9.5 mm (left end) thick, 105 g; grip bar on top 31.75 mm thick and 16 mm high, running 25 mm past each end (ears over the recesses). It sits in the slot, grip resting on the top, flat back face toward the rear. (3) Lint mat on its front face: 345 x 118 x 3 mm, 2 g, held to the mesh until about 1.5 N tears it off. (4) Waste tray on the table against the front of the dryer: inside 18 x 40 cm, 4 cm high (rim 1.25 cm below the cabinet top), centre 9.3 cm in front of the dryer's front face on its centre line. Each trial moves the dryer, button and bin together by 6 to 15 mm in x (either sign) and up to 30 mm in y, from the trial seed; named check setups in the README.
scoring: The dryer starts when Start is pressed with 4 N or more for 0.5 s (sim: contact force; bench: the calibrated Start indicator latches). The screen and lint state at that moment counts; fixing things after starting does not. 1.0 (ends the trial): started while the screen was fully seated (grip down on the top at both ends within 2.5 mm, right way round; a 2.5 mm feeler does not pass under either end) and clean (no lint on it, none dropped into the dryer), screen still seated after, lint in the bin, held 1 s. 0.5: as 1.0 but the lint lies outside the bin (dryer top, table, floor). 0.25: never started, lint in the bin and screen seated. 0: started with lint on the screen, lint inside the dryer, or the screen out, reversed or more than 2.5 mm proud at an end; or nothing done.
reset_notes: Use a single 345 × 118 mm Vlieseline 249 mat (1.8–2.2 g, 2.5–3.5 mm). Centre it on the front mesh 6 mm above the bottom; press the calibrated hook spot with 200 g for 2 s. Verify retention upright, seat both ends, empty the tray and clear Start. Lot force test, templates and trial offsets in the README.
fidelity: Isaac Lab-Arena PhysX (480 Hz; 20 Hz control). Maytag LNC7764A71 Series 11 uses 53-0918 at its door. The bench equivalent and simulation share a rectangular tapered screen, grip ears and horizontal guide; DXFs define the interfaces. Screen envelope and grip width follow the replacement listing. Real trials use soft batting and a calibrated hook spot; the simulation uses a rigid 3 mm plate and a 1.5 N breakable joint. Physical fit and peel targets await bench measurement.
run_limit: 2400 control steps (2 min at 20 Hz). The trial also ends as soon as the score reaches 1.0.
scores: Scripted reference scored 1.0 in 1,226 steps. Dream-1 scored 0.0 in 2,400 steps (seed 0; limit 2,400). Starting with lint attached scored 0.0.
